text.body: <1> || śrīḥ || jñāpakasaṃgrahapariśiṣṭam (1) (vivṛtyā sametam) || prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || jñāpakasaṃgrahe nāgeśena asaṃgṛhītāni bhāṣyārūḍhāni vacanāni saṃkalayya atra vyākhyāyante | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa eoṅ | aiauc | "ami pūrvaḥ' (sū.6-1-107) iti pūrvagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ yathājātīyakaḥ pūrvastathājātīyaka ubhayorbhavatīti | nānena saṃprasāraṇasya dīrgho bhavatītyatra "halaḥ' (sū.6-4-3) iti sūtraṃ jñāpakam | rūpagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ yathājātīyakaṃ parasya rūpaṃ tathājātīyakamubhayoriti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaādguṇaḥ' (sū.6-1-87) ityādiṣu ekādeśavidhāyakasūtreṣu dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam pūrvaparayoḥ pūrvaparayoḥ sthāne bhavan guṇavṛddhyādiḥ dvimātra eva yathā syāt sthānyanusāreṇa trimātraścaturmātro vā mā bhūdityevamarthama iti vārtikakāreṇokte bhāṣyakāraḥ-- dīrghagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, yogavibhāgādeveṣṭasiddheḥ | "akaḥ savarṇe' ityeko yogaḥ | tasya cākaḥ savarṇe pare eko bhavatītyarthaḥ | tato "dīrghaḥ' ityeko yogaḥ | tasya ca "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ' ityevaṃ nirdiṣṭe yaḥ sa dīrghaḥ---dvimātro bhavatītyarthaḥ iti pratyapādayat | tadupari "paśum, viddham, pacanti' ityatrāpyekādeśo dvimātro bhavedityāśaṅkya jñāpakena samādhānamuktam | tadāha--ami pūrva iti | ayamāśayaḥ--paśum ityatra paśuaam iti sthite pūrvaparayorukārākārayoḥ sthāne pūrva ukāra ādeśo bhavati, sa dvimātro bhavet sati dīrghagrahaṇe iti śaṅkā | yadyatra dvimātra ādeśaḥ syāt tadā pūrvagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt | prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇa ityataḥ pūrvasavarṇānuvṛttyaiveṣṭalābhāt | evaṃ sthite yatpūrvagrahaṇaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati yathājātīyakaḥ pūrvastathājātīyaka evobhayoḥ sthāne bhavatīti | tathā ca paśumityatra ekādeśaḥ pūrvajātīyaḥ-- ekamātra eva bhavatīti samādhānam | tathā viddhamityatra vyadhadhātoḥ ktapratyaye saṃprasāraṇe vi adhta iti sthite "saṃprasāraṇācca' (sū.6-1-108) ityanena bhavat pūrvarūpaṃ dvimātraṃ bhavediti śaṅkā | yadi dvimātraṃ bhavettadā "hala' iti sūtreṇa hala uttarasya saṃprasāraṇasya dīrghaṃ na vidadhyāt, dvimātrātmakapūrvarūpeṇaiva iṣṭasiddheḥ | atastatsūtraṃ jñāpayati "saṃprasāraṇācca' iti sūtreṇa bhavat pūrvarūpaṃ dīrghātmakaṃ neti | ato na doṣa iti samādhānam | tathā pacantītyatra pacaaantīti sthite "ato guṇo' (sū.6-1-97) ityanena pararūpaṃ dīrghatmakaṃ bhavediti śaṅkā | pararūpamiti rūpagrahaṇāt yathājātīyakaṃ parasya rūpaṃ tathājātīyakamevobhayoḥ sthāne bhavatīti jñāpyate | ato'tra ekamātra evādeśo bhavatīti samādhānam | jhrjñā.paṭa dīrghācche tugvidhānāt jñāpakāt na dīrghe hrasvāśrayo vidhirbhavatīti | jhrvidṛṭa varṇaikadeśā varṇagrahaṇena gṛhyanta iti pakṣe ālūya pralūya ityādau hrasvagrahaṇena ūkāraikadeśasya ukārasyāpi grahaṇāt "hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (sū.6-1-71) iti tukprasaṅga ityāśaṅkyāha--dīrghāccha iti | cecchidyata ityādau tugāgamasiddhaye hi "dīrghāt' (sū.6-1-75) iti sūtramārabhyate | tatrāpyekāraikadeśasya ikārasya hrasvaśabdena grahaṇāt "che ca' (sū.6-1-73) ityanenaiva tuksiddheḥ dīrghāt iti sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ sat dīrghe hrasvamāśritya vidhīyamānaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavatīti jñāpayati | ato na ālūyetyādau tugāpattiriti bhāvaḥ |jhrjñā.pa.ṭa gāpoṣṭak (sū.3-2-8) iti kakārānubandho jñāpayati nākārasthasya akārasya lopo bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu varṇaikadeśā varṇagrahaṇena gṛhyanta iti pakṣe yātā vātā ityādau ākāraikadaśasya akārasya "ato lopaḥ' (sū.6-4-48) iti lopaḥ prāpnotītyāśaṅkyāha--gāpoṣṭak iti | "gāpoṣṭak' iti sūtreṇa gāyateḥ pibateścānupasarge karmaṇyupapade ṭakpratyayo vidhīyate | sāmagaḥ surāpa ityudāraṇam | ṭaki kakārānubandhaḥ sāmagā a ityatra "āto lopa iṭi ca' (sū.6-4-64) ityākāralopārthaṃ kriyate | sa māstu | ākārāvayavasya akārasya "ato lopaḥ' (sū.6-4-48) iti lope kṛte sāmaga a a iti sthite dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpeṇeṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyatīti kimākāralopārthena kakārānubandhena | sa kriyamāṇaḥ ākārasthasya akārasya lopo na bhavatīti jñāpayati | tathā ca akāralopābhāve ākārasyāpi yadi lopo na syāt tadeṣṭarūpāsiddheḥ ālopārthaṃ kakārānubandha iti svāṃśe cāritārthyam | prayojanaṃ tu yātā tā ityādāvato lopo na bhavatīti | yadyapi kakāranubandhasya ākārasya guṇo na bhavatītyarthajñāpakatvam "ikoguṇavṛddhī' (sū.1-1-3) iti sūtre bhāṣye proktam, tathāpi ekasyobhayajñāpakatvaṃ na virudhyata iti bodhyam | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ tatra tatra pradīpādau | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa gonaugrahaṇāt jñāpakāt dīrghe vdhdyajlakṣaṇo vidhirna bhavati | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaekavarṇavacca' iti vārtikam | tasya ca dīrgha ākārādiḥ hrasvākāradvayasamudāyarūpo'pi ekavarṇena tulyo bhavatīti vaktavyam | anyathā vācā taratītyarthe vākśabdāt "nauvdyacaṣṭhan' (sū.4-4-7) iti ṭhan pratyayaḥ syādityarthaḥ | idaṃ vārtikaṃ jñāpakenānyathāsiddhamityāśayenāha--gonaugrahaṇāditi | okārasya akāra-ukārasamudāyarūpatvena gośabdasya vdyactvāt "vdyac' ityanenaiva gośabdasyāpi grahaṇe siddhe "govdyaco'saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvāderyat' (sū.5-1-39) iti sūtre gograhaṇaṃ vyartham | tathā "nauvdyacaṣṭhan' iti sūtre naugrahaṇaṃ ca vyartham | atastadubhayaṃ jñāpayati dīrghe vdyajlakṣaṇo virdhirneti | ato na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ | tathā ca "ekavarṇavacca' iti vārtikamanāvaśyakam| tatphalasya jñāpakenaiva siddherityavadheyam | jhrjñā.paṭa iko guṇavṛddhī (sū.1-1-3)|| "gāpoṣṭak' (sū.3-2-8) ityananyārthakakārānubandhakaraṇāt jñāpakāt na ākārasya guṇo bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaiko guṇavṛddhī' iti sūtre "iggrahaṇamākārasandhyakṣaravyañjananivṛttyartham' iti vārtikam | yātā vātetyādau ākārasya "sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (sū.7-3-84) iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti, iggrahaṇācca sa na bhavatīti prathamaṃ prayojanam | idaṃ ca prayojanaṃ bhāṣyakāraḥ pratyācakhyau | tathā hi-iggrahaṇasya nākāranivṛttiḥ prayojanam | ākārasya guṇo na bhavatīti jñāpakamahimnā avagamāt | "gāpoṣṭak' (sū.3-2-8) iti sūtre pratyaye kitkaraṇamākārasya guṇo na bhavatītyatra jñāpakam | tena hi sūtreṇānupasṛṣṭābhyāṃ gāpābhyāṃ karmaṇyupapade ṭakpratyayo vidhīyate | sāmagāaṭak (a) iti sthite "āto lopa iṭi ca' ityākāralope sāmaga iti bhavati | pratyayasya kittvamākāralopārthaṃ kriyate | tanmāstu | ṭa ityeva pratyayo'stu | ākārasya "sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' iti guṇe akāre sāmagaaa iti sthite dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpeṇa sāmaga iti rūpamākāralopaṃ vinaiva sidhyati | tathā ca kakārānubanghaḥ vyarthaḥ san ākārasya guṇo na bhavatīti jñāpayati | guṇābhāve ākāralope cāsati iṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ na sidhyediti ālopārtha kakārānubandhakāraṇamiti svāṃśe cāritārthyaṃm | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu yātā vātetyādau ākārasya guṇo na bhavatīti | tathā ca jñāpakenaiva ākārasya guṇābhāve siddhe tadarthamiggrahaṇamiti na yuktamiti bhāṣyāśayaḥ | tadāha--gāpoṣṭak iti | ananyārtheti | ākāralopātiriktaprayojanarahitetyarthaḥ | "āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (sū.3-2-3) iti kakārānubandhasya "tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ' (sū.3-2-5) ityatra prayojanaṃ bhavitumarhati | na tādṛśamanyatprayojanamasti ṭakaḥ kakārānubandhasyetyāśayenaivamuktam | jhrjñā.paṭa īdūtau ca (sū.1-1-19)|| na pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃpratyayalakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyatrārthagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "īdūtau ca saptamyarthe' iti sūtre arthagrahaṇaṃ māstu | na ca tadabhāve "somo gaurī adhiśritaḥ' ityatra saptamyāḥ luptatvena saptamīrūpasya īkārasyābhāvāt pragṛhyasaṃjñā na syāt | iṣyate ca sā | tadarthamarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | kṛte ca tasmin saptamyāḥ luptatveṣaḍaḍḍatdh;pi tadarthasadbhāvāt pragṛhyasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti vācyam | arthagrahaṇābhāve'pi saptamīrūpayorīdūtorasaṃbhavena vacanabalāt saptamīsahacaritamīdūdantamityarthalābhāt saptamyāḥ luptatve'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena saptamīsahacaritatvamastīti pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāḥ siddherarthagrahaṇavairyathyatādavasthyādityāśaṅkyāha--na pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāmiti | yadi pragṛhyasaṃjñāprakāraṇe pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ syāttadā "īdūtau saptamī' ityanenaiva saptamīsahacaritamīdūdantaṃ pragṛhyamityarthakena luptāyāmapi saptamyāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena pūrvoktarītyā saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti kim arthagrahaṇena |tatkriyamāṇaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvaṃ sūcayati | tathā ca vāpyaśva ityādau pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ prayojanamiti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa bahugaṇa (sū.1-1-23)|| "vatoriḍḍḍatdh;vā' (sū.5-1-23) ityādijñāpakāt bahugaṇādīnāṃ saṃkhyākārthaṃ bhavati | jhrviṭa ṭhabahugaṇavatuḍaḍḍatdh;ti saṃkhyā' iti sūtraṃ bahugaṇādīnāṃ saṃkhyāsaṃjñāṃ bodhayati | idaṃ sūtraṃ tyaktuṃ śakyam | na ca tarhi vidhipradeśeṣu saṃkhyāśabdena teṣāṃ kathaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam | jñāpakena baḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|vādīnāṃ saṃkhyākārthaṃ bhavatītyavagamāt | tathā hi--"vatoriḍḍḍatdh;vā' iti sūtreṇa vatvantātparasya kanaḥ iḍaḍḍatdh;āgamo vidhīyate, tāvatikaḥ tāvatkaḥ ityudāharaṇam | kanpratyayaśca "saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' (sū.5-1-22) iti sūtreṇa prāpayitavyaḥ | yadi vatvantasya saṃkhyāśabdena grahaṇaṃ na syāt tadā tataḥ kano'prāptyā tataḥ parasya kanaḥ iḍiḍḍatdh;vadhānaṃ nopapadyeta | tadvidhānasārmathyācca vatvantasya saṃkhyākārthaṃ bhavatīti jñāyate | evaṃ "bahupūgagaṇasaṅghasya tithuk' (sū.5-2-52) iti sūtreṇa bahugaṇaśabdayoḥ ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭi pare tithugāgamo vidhīyate | ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭra ca "tasya pūraṇe ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭra' (sū.5-2-48) ityanena prāpaṇiyaḥ | tathoḥ saṃkhyāśabdena agrahaṇe ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭo'prāptyā tasmin pare āgamavidhānamanupapannaṃ sat bahugaṇayoḥ saṃkhyākārthaṃ jñāpayati | evaṃ "ṣaṭūkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk' (sū.5-2-51) iti sūtreṇa ḍaḍḍatdh;tyantāt katiśabdāt saṃkhyāyāḥ vihite ḍaḍḍatdh;ti pare vidhīyamānaḥ thugāgamaḥ ḍaḍḍatdh;tyantasyāpi saṃkhyākārthaṃ bhavatīti jñāpayati | evaṃ vatuviṣaye "vatorathiuk' (sū.5-2-53) iti sūtramapi saṃkhyākāryasya jñāpakam | tathā ca bahugaṇavatuḍaḍḍatdh;ti saṃkhyā' iti sūtraṃ pratyākhyeyamiti bhāṣye sthitam | tadetadabhipretyāha--vatoriḍḍḍatdh;vā ityādijñāpakāditi | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa avyayībhāvaśca (sū 1-1-41)|| "nāvyayībhāvāt' (sū.2-4-83) iti pratiṣedhāt jñāpakāt bhavatyavyayībhāvālluk | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaavyayībhāvaśca' iti sūtreṇāvyayībhāvasamāsasyāvyayasaṃjñā codyate | tatprayojanaṃ ca "luṅūmukhasvaropacārāḥ' iti vārtike proktam | upāgni pratyagri ityādau avyayībhāvāt parasya supaḥ "avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti sūtreṇa lugvaktavyaḥ | sa cāvyayībhāvasyāvyayasaṃjñāṃ vinā na saṃbhavatīti luk prathamaṃ prayojanam | tacca jñāpakādeva nirvahati | tathā hi "nāvyayībhāvādato'm tvapañcamyāḥ ' (sū.2-4-83) iti sūtreṇa adantādavyayībhāvātparasya supaḥ luk na bhavatīti yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ saḥ "avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti sūtreṇa prāptasya luka iti vaktavyam | avyayībhāvasyāvyayatvābhāve subluko'prāptyā tanniṣedho vyarthaḥ san bhavatyavyayībhāvātparasya supo lugiti jñāpayati | tathā cāvyayasaṃjñāṃ vinaiva jñāpakādevāvyayībhāvātparasya supo luksiddheḥ tatprayojanakatvamavyayībhāvasyavyayasaṃjñāyā na yujyata iti bhāṣye sthitam | tadāha--nāvyayībhāvāditi | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa na lumatā (sū.1-1-63)|| sātpratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ svādiṣu padatvena yeṣāṃ padasaṃjñā na tebhyaḥ pratiṣedha iti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhana lumatāṅgasya' iti sūtre "uttarapadatve cāpadādividhā' viti vārtikam | uttarapadasya padavyapadeśe kartavye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati padādividhiṃ varjayitvā iti tadarthaḥ | paramavācā ityādau paramā ca sā vāk ceti vigrahe paramā sū vāc su iti sthite samāse tadavayavasuporluki samudāyādvibhaktau satyāṃ paramavācā iti bhavati | tatra vāc ityasya samāsārthā yā vibhaktiḥ kṛtā tāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇenāśritya subantatvāt padasaṃjñāyāṃ "coḥ kuḥ' (sū.8-2-30) iti kutvaṃ prāpnoti | ataḥ uttarapadasya padatvavyapadeśe kartavye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavatītivaktavyam | evaṃ cet dadhisecāvityatra dadhnaḥ secāviti vigrahe samāsāvayavasuporluki pratyayalakṣaṇena padatvamāśritya "sātpadādyoḥ' (sū.8-3-111) iti ṣatvaniṣedha iṣyate, sa na syāt ata uktam apadādividhāviti | ṣatvaniṣedhasya padādividhitvāt pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeveti na doṣa iti vārtikāśayaḥ | bhāṣyakārastu "yaci bham' ityasya yajādipratyaye pūrvaṃ bhasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānaṃ kṛtvā "paramavācā' ityādau bhatvātpadatvābhāvena kutvāprāptervārtikaṃ pratyākhyeyamityupapādayāmāsa | tadupari yadi vārtikaṃ prātyākhyāyate tarhi "apadādividhau pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedho na'ityarthasyālābhāt "dadhisesau' ityādau padāditvaprayuktaṣatvapratiṣedhaḥ kathaṃ sādhanīyaḥ ityāśaṅkāyāmāha sma bhāṣyakāraḥ "sātpadādyoḥ' iti sūtre padasyādiriti na vigrahaḥ, api tu padādādiriti | tathā ca daghi iti padāt parasya ādeḥ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti | tadupari--tarhi ṛkṣu vākṣu ityādiṣvapi ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ syāt ṛkśabdasya svādiṣviti padatvāt tataḥ parasya ādeḥ pratyayādeḥ sakārasyāpi ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ prāpnotītyāśaṅkya, svādiṣviti sūtreṇa yeṣāṃ padasaṃjñā tataḥ parasya ṣatvapratiṣegho na bhavati | ataḥ vākṣu ityādau na doṣaḥ | dadhisecāvatyitra tu antarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya "suptiṅantaṃ padam ' (sū.1-4-14) iti dadhiśabdasya padasaṃjñā na "svādiṣu' iti | ataḥ tataḥ parasya sakārasya ṣatvaniṣedho bhavatyeva | uktaviṣaye jñāpakaṃ tu "sātpadādyoḥ' iti sūtre sādgrahaṇam | taddhi agnisādityādau ṣatvaniṣedhāya | agni ityasya "svādiṣu' iti padatvāttataḥ parasya sakārasya padādāderityanenaiva ṣatvaniṣedhe labdhe sādgrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | kṛtaṃ ca tat uktavacanaṃ jñāpayati iti samādhānamuktaṃ bhāṣye | tadeva paṭhati-- sātpratiṣedho jñāpaka iti | jhrjñā.paṭa sthānivadādeśo (sū.1-1-56)|| "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe (sū.7-2-86) ityādeśe pratiṣedhāt jñāpakāt sthānivadādeśo bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa sthānivatsūtraṃ pratyākhyātumāha--yuṣmadasmadoriti | "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' iti sūtreṇa halodau vibhaktau parato yuṣmadasmadorākāraṃ vidhāya ādeśe parataḥ ātvaṃ pratiṣidhyate | tatra vibhaktayādeśasya vibhaktitvābhāvādeva ādeśe parata ātvāprasakteḥ kimanādeśa iti pratiṣedhena | sa kriyamāṇaḥ ādeśaḥ sthānivat iti jñāpayati | tataśca vibhattayādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena vibhaktitvamādāya tasmin parata igantātparasya jhalādeḥ sanaḥ kittvaṃ vidhīyate | bumūṣatītyādikamudāharaṇam | tatra jhalgrahaṇena śiśayiṣate ityādau seṭaḥ ata evājādeḥ sanaḥ kittvaṃ vyārvatyata iti vaktavyam | paraṃ tu "na ktvā seṭaṃ' ityatra ktvāgrahaṇābhāve seṭaḥ yasya kasyāpi kittvāniṣedhāt śiśayiṣate ityatra seṭaḥ sano'pi kittvaniṣedhalābhāt tatphalakam "iko jhal' iti sūtre jhalgrahaṇamanarthakam | tatkriyamāṇaṃ "na seṭ' iti sūtre aupadeśikasya kittvasya pratiṣedho nātideśikasyeti jñāpayati | seṭaḥ sanaḥ aupadeśikaṃ kittvaṃ nāsti, api tu "iko jhak' ityanena ātideśikam | tasya ca "na seṭ'ityanena pratiṣedho na vācyam | ekadeśānumatidvārā tatsiddheriti kecit | kaiyaṭastu kārakāṇāṃ "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (sū.2-3-32) iti samāsaḥ kriyate | tatra kṛdgrahaṇāt subutpatteḥ prāk samāsaḥ siddhaḥ | tiṅantena hi tṛtīyānātasya supetyasyānuvṛttyaiva samāsāprasaṅgāt kṛdantenaiva samāse siddhe kṛdgrahaṇaṃ kṛdantāvasthāyāmevānutpanne supi samāsārtham ityāha | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa anekamanyapadārthe (sū.2-2-24)|| vārtikam | tatra tārdathyaśabdasya tasmai arthastadarthaḥ tadarthasya bhāvaḥ tārdathyamiti niṣpattirmavati | tatra tasmai iti caturthyantasyārthaśabdena samāso na saṃbhavati, arthaśabdena yoge atra bharatagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati anyatra prāggrahaṇe bharatagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "baḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|vaca iñaḥ' iti sūtre "prācyabharateṣu' dvandvasamāsaḥ uta karmadhārayaḥ | yadā paścadbahūni vidhāsyan madhye vibhāṣādhikāraṃ kutaḥ karoti ? samāsavidhānārambha eva vibāṣādhikāro'stu ityāśaṅkyāha--etatsārmathyāditi | madhye vibhāṣādhikārasārmathyādevetaḥ prācīnānāṃ ityādisamāsavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | tastadvidhānaṃ "saha supā' iti samāsasya vaikalpikatvaṃ jñāpayatīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa pūrvasadṛśa (2-1-31)|| miśragrahaṇe sopasargasyāpi grahaṇam | "miśraṃ jñāpayati | tathā ca tilasaṃmiśrā ityādau svaravāraṇārthamanupakalgagrahaṇamiti svāṃśe cāritārthyaṃm | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu "pūrvasadṛśa' ityādisūtre miśraśabdena saṃmiśraśabdasyāpi grahaṇāt "tadasminnadhikam' (sū.5-2-45) iti "yasmādadhikam' (sū.2-3-9) iti ca sūtranirdeśāt | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "loke lokādvā adhiko hariḥ' ityādau adhikaśabdayoge pañcamīsaptamyoḥ vidhāyakasūtrābhāvāt kathaṃ tata iti pañcamyāstasiḥ iti bālamanoramākārāḥ prāhuḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa apaparibahiḥ (sū.2-1-12) iti samāsavidhānāt jñāpakāt bahiryoge pañcamī | jhrvi.ṭa evaṃ bahiryoge pañcamīvidhāyakasūtrasyābhāve'pi ktapratyayasya pāṇininā nirdeśāt "matibuddhi' iti sūtravihitaḥ ktapratyayaḥ bhūte ktasya nāpavādaḥ iti sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa yajayāca (sū.3-3-90)|| "praśne cāsanna' (sū.3-2-117) iti iti sūtreṇa ghapratyayo vidhīyate | ākhanaḥ ityudāharaṇam | tatra pratyaye ghakāraḥ itsaṃjñakaḥ | tasya ca prakṛte prayojanaṃ nāsti | dhātau cajorabhāvena "cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' (sū.7-3-42) iti na pravartata iti bhāvaḥ | yadyapi tatraiva śravaṇā iti lupā nirdeśātkathamevaṃ jñāpayituṃ śakyata iti śaṅkā avatarati tathāpi tathā nirdeśāt tatra paraṃ lubabhāvaḥ jñāpyata iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa na vyo liṭi (sū.6-1-46) | paramapi halādiśeṣaṃ bādhitvā yasya saṃprasāraṇam, ubhayeṣāṃ grahaṇasārmathyāt | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "vyeñ saṃvaraṇe' iti dhātorliṭi ṇali vye a iti sthite "aco ñṇiti' (sū.7-2-115) | tathā ca halādiśeṣaṃ bādhitvā abyāsayakārasya saṃprasāraṇe vivyāyeti rūpaṃ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa dīrghāt (sū.6-1-75)|| dīrghasyāyaṃ tuk na tu chasya| "senāsurācchāyā' (sū.2-4-25) iti jñāpakāt | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "dīrghāt' iti sūtre "che ca' (sū.6-1-73) iti sūtrāt che ityanuvartate | pañcamīṣaṣṭhyorubhayornirdeśasthale pañcamīnirdeśasya balīyastvena dīrghāt ityeṣā pañcamī che iti pāṇininirdeśaḥ | yadi hi chasya tuk syāt tarhi chakāropari cakāro nirdiśyeta | dīrghādupari cakāranirdeśamahimnā tu dīrghasyāyaṃ tugiti jñāpayatīti bhāvaḥ | "senāsurācchāyā' iti nirdeśāt dīrghāditi pañcamyantasya ṣaṣṭhyantatvajñāpanadvārā dīrghasyāyaṃ tugiti jñāpyat iti paramārthaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa iko yaṇaci (sū.6-1-77)|| sthānitvena nimittatvamiko na bādhyate | "tasmādityuttarasya' (sū.1-1-67) jhrvi.ṭa saṃpūrvasya paripūrvasya ca karoteḥ bhūṣaṇe saṃghāte cārthe sūṭpratyayo vidhīyate "saṃparibhyāṃ karotau bhūṣaṇe' "samavāye ca' iti sūtrābhyām | na kevalamuktārthayoreva suṭ, arthāntare'pi takārarūpavikāreṇānvitatvāt cakārema pūrvasūtrāt anukṛṣyamāṇasya kyapaḥ pratisaṃbandhyanirdeśāt kyabvidhānānupapattiḥ ityāśaṅkya, tatra dhātoḥ iti pañcamyantaṃ padamanuvartate, ataḥ hanastakāro bhavati, dhātoḥ kyap bhavatīti vākyārtha iti samādhāya, tarhi dhātusāmānyāt kyap prāpnotīti punarāśaṅkya jñāpakena dhātusāmānyāt kyabāpattirnivāritā | tadāha--etistu iti parigaṇanamiti | yadi dhātumātrāt kyap bhavet tarhi etistu ityādibyo'pi "hanasta ca' (sū.3-1-109) iti parigaṇanamanarthakaṃ syāt | kṛtaṃ ca tatparigaṇanaṃ na sarvasmādapi dhātoḥ kyap bhavatīti jñāpayatītyarthaḥ | jhrjñā.paṭa paraśca (sū.3-1-2)|| kādyanubandhāsañjanaṃ jñāpayati atyantāparadṛṣṭāḥ parabhūtā lupyanta iti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaparaśca' iti sūtrasya "atyantāparadṛṣṭānāṃ vā parabhūtalopārtha' miti vārtikakāraḥ prayojanamuktavān | pareṇa-pradhānena pratyakṣeṇa na kvaciddṛṣṭā ye kkibādayasteṣāṃ parabhūtānāṃ lopo bhavatu ityetadarthaṃ paraśceti sūtram | tathā sati hi kiti ityādinā vihitaṃ kārthaṃ kkipi pare syānnānyathā iti tadarthaḥ | tadetadvārtikaṃ bhāṣyakāraḥ jñāpakena kkibādīnāṃ parabhūtānāṃ lopaṃ prasādhya pratyākhyātavān | tadāha--kādyanubandhāsañjanamiti | yadi pūrvabhūtā lupyeraṃstadā kkibādau kakārādyanubandhāsañcanamanarthakaṃ syāt | sarvasyānubandhakārthasya parabhūtapratyayanimittakatvāt | tathā ca tat sarvalopinaḥ pratyayāḥ parabhūtā eva lupyanta iti jñāpayatītyarthaḥ | jhrjñā.paṭa ijādeśca (sū.3-2-36)|| "ṛcchatyṝtām' (sū.7-4-11) iti ṛccherliṭi guṇavacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ rnaccherliṭyām bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ijñādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ' iti sūtre anṛcchaḥ iti māstu| na ca tadabhāve ṛcchadhātorapyām syāditi vācyam | jñāpakenaiva ṛccherām na bhavatītyavagamāt | jñāpakamevāha--ṛccherliṭīti | "ṛcchatyṝtām' iti sūtreṇa hi ṛccherliṭi guṇo vidhīyate | yadi ca ṛccherliṭyām syāt tadā āmā vyavadhānena liṭparakatvābhāvāt guṇo na prarvatsyatīti guṇavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | ato guṇavidhānena ṛccherāmabhāvo jñāpyate | tathā ca tenaiva āmniṣedhe siddhe "anṛcchaḥ' iti pratiṣedho vyartha iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjña.pa.ṭa sārvadhātuke yak (sū.3-1-67)|| "na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' (sū.3-1-89) iti pratiṣedhāt jñāpakāt bhacavati karmakartari yak | jhrvi.ṭa nanu bhāvavācini karmavācini ca sārvadhātuke parato vidhīyamāno yak karmakartari lakāre pare na prāpnoti | kartari śapo'pavādatvāt prāpterityata āha--na duheti | "na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti sūtreṇa duhasnunamāṃ karmakartṛlakāre pare yakciṇau pratiṣidhyete | sa cāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ dhātoḥ karmakartari yagabhāve prāptyabhāvādasaṃgataḥ san karmakartari yagbhavatītyatra jñāpaka iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa kṛdatiṅ (sū.3-1-93)|| kvacittaddhitavidhau "tiṅaśca' (sū.5-3-56) iti tiṅgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ na tiṅantādaṇādayo bhavantīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu kṛdatiṅ iti sūtre atiṅgrahaṇaṃ māstu | na ca tadabhāve tiṅo'pi kṛtsaṃjñā syāt, tataśca kṛdantatvāt paṭhatītyādeḥ pratipādikasaṃjñā syāditi vācyam | prātipadikasaṃjñāyāmapi doṣābhāvāt | ekatvādīnām tiṅoktatvāt subādīnām, tiṅantasya strītvena yogābhāvādeva ṭābādīnāṃ cāpādayitumaśakyatvāt | ca cāṇādayastaddhitāstiṅantebhyo bhaveyuriti vācyam | apatyādyarthe taddhitavidhānena tiṅantasyāpatyādibhiryogābhāvādeva tatastaddhitotpatterāpādayitumaśakyatvāt | yadvā jñāpakādeva tiṅantādaṇādyutpattervārayituṃ śakyatvāt | jñāpakamevāha--kvacittaddhitavidhāviti | yadi tiṅantasyāpi prātipadikatvāt tatastaddhitotpattiḥ syāt tadā taddhitaprakaraṇe "tiṅaśca'(sū.5-3-56) iti sūtramanarthakaṃ bhavet | "atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' (sū.5-3-55) iti sūtreṇaiva siddheḥ | tataśca tiṅaḥ kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ taṅintasya pratipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ ca doṣābhāvāt "kṛdatiṅ' iti sūtre atiṅgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyeyamityāśayaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa kṛtyāḥ (sū.3-1-95)|| arhe kṛtyatṛcgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ prāṅ ṇvuluḥ kṛtyasaṃjñā bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu kṛtyāḥ iti sūtre prāṅṇvula iti vaktavyam | anyathā ṇvulo'pi kṛtyasaṃjñāprasaṅgādityāśaṅkyāha--arhe kṛtyeti | yadi hi "ṇvultṛcau' iti sūtrātprāgeva kṛtyasaṃjñā ityetanna syāttadā tṛco'pi kṛtyasaṃjñakatvena "arhekṛtyāḥ' ityeva sūtrayituṃ śakyam | tṛjgrahaṇaṃ cānarthakam | yataḥ "arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' (sū.3-3-169) iti sūtre pṛthak tṛcagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tenānumīyate ṇvulaḥ prāk kṛtyasaṃjñeti | na coktajñāpakena tṛcaḥ prāk kṛtyasaṃjñetyarthalābhe'pi ṇvulaḥ prāgiti na labhyata iti vācyam | jñāpakasya sūtrāpekṣatvena tṛcghaṭitāt "ṇvultṛcau' iti sūtrāt prāk kṛtyasaṃjñādhikāra ityevaṃ jñāpanāt | tathā ca jñāpakena siddheḥ "prāṅṇvulaḥ' iti na vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | kāśikāyāṃ "kṛtyāḥ prāṅṇvulaḥ' iti yaḥ sūtrapāṭhaḥ so'nādaraṇīya iti siddham | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa spṛhigṛhi--(sū.3-2-158)|| luśā siddhe ālujvidhānaṃ jñāpakam anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc' iti sūtre āluc iti guruḥ pratyayo na vidhīyatām | luś iti pratyaya evavidhīyatām | śapi kṛte spṛhayaalu iti sthite "ato dīrgho yañi' (sū.7-3-101) iti dīrgheṇa spṛhayāluḥ ityādirūpasiddherityāśaṅkyāha--luśeti | tathā ca ālucaḥ vidhānaṃ sūtrānirdiṣṭebhyo'pi dhātubhyaḥ āluc bhavatīti jñāpayati | tathā ca śayaluḥ ityādikaṃ sidhyati | tatra hi śapaḥ "adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ' (sū.2-4-72) iti luki ato dīrghasyāsaṃbhavāt luśā nirvāho na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa anadyatane luṭ (sū.3-3-15) || anadyatane lṛṭaṛ satsaṃjñāvacanaṃ jñāpayati bhavatyanadyatane lṛḍiḍḍatdh;ti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhalṛṭaḥ sadvā'(sū.3-3-14) "anadyatane luṭ' iti sūtrakramaḥ | tatra "anadyatane' "luṭ' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ | "anadyatane' iti sūtre "lṛṭaḥ sat' ityanuvartate | anadyatane lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau śatṛśānacau ādeśau bhavata iti tadarthaḥ | "tena śvo'gnīnādāsyamānena' "śvaḥ somena yakṣyamāṇena' ityādikaṃ sidhyati | na cānadyatane lṛḍiḍḍatdh;vadhāyakanuśāsanābhāvena kathametaditi vācyam | yogavibhāgena anadyatane lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakādeśavidhānenaiva anadyatane lṛḍaḍḍatdh;stīti jñāpanāditi bhāṣye pratipāditam | tadāha--anadyatane lṛṭa iti jhrjñā.pa.ṭa āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca (sū.3-3-132)|| "saṃbhāvane'lamiti cet' (sū.3-3-154) iti jñāpakāt saṃbhāvane'pi nālarmathyaṃ gamyate | jhrvi.ṭa nanvāsaṃsāsaṃbhāvanayoraviśeṣāt āśaṃsāyāṃ ye vidhīyante te saṃbhāvane'pi prāpnuvanti | ye ca saṃbhāvane vidhīyante te āśaṃsāyāmapi prāpnuvanti | na ca saṃbhāvane'lamartho niyamena gamyate, āśaṃsāyāṃ tu alamartho na gamyate | tathā ca tayorarthāviśeṣe'pyālarmathyākṛtabhedo'sti | tamādāya vyavasthā bhaviṣyatīti noktadoṣa iti vācyam | tathā sati "saṃbhāvane'lamiti cet' (sū.3-3-154) iti sūtre alamiti cet iti viśeṣaṇavairyathyāt | yadi hi saṃbhāvane niyamenālamartho gamyeta tadā vyabhicārābhāvāt alamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ nepādīyeta | saṃbhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ hi syādviśeṣaṇamarthavat | tathā ca saṃbhāvanāśaṃsayorālarmathyatadabhāvakṛto viśeṣo na vaktuṃ śakya iti sthitam | tadāha saṃbhāvana iti | tarhi tayorviśeṣābhāve pūrvoktāvyavasthāyāḥ kaḥ parihāra iti cet idaṃ me bhūyādityākārakecchāviśeṣaḥ āśaṃsā| ekatarakoṭikāniścitajñānaviśeṣaḥ saṃbhāvanamiti tayorbhedāt vyavasthā saṃgacchata iti kaiyaṭaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa tumarthe se-(sū.3-4-9)|| tumarthagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati astyanyaḥ kartustumuno'rtha iti | jhrvidṛṭa ṭhatumarthe sesenase-' ityādinā sūtreṇa tumuno'rthe se sen ityādayaḥ pratyayā vaidikaprakaraṇe vidhīyante | tatra tumuno'rthaḥ kaḥ ? iti saṃdeho jāyate | na tāvat kartā tumuno'rthaḥ | tathā sati kartari se sen ityādayo bhavantīti sūtrārthaḥ syāt | tadā tumartha iti padaṃ vyartham | "kartari kṛt' ityanenaiva teṣāṃ kartrarthakatvāvagamasaṃbhavāt | ata āha--tumarthagrahaṇamiti | tathā ca pūrvoktarītyā tumarthagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ sat karturanyo'pi tumuno'rtho'stīti jñāpayati | sa ca bhāvaḥ bhāve ca sesenādaya iṣyante | tadarthaṃ tumarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ jñāpane prayojanaṃ tu "avyayakṛto bhāve' ityetadvārtikaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati | tumarthagrahaṇānuvṛttyaivaavyayakṛtāṃ ktvādīnāṃ bhāvārthakatvasiddheriti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa kartari kṛt (sū.3-4-67)|| "tayoreva' (sū.3-4-70) ityevakāro jñāpayati ita uttaraṃ samāveśo bhavatīti | "ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca' (sū.3-4-71) iti cakāro jñāpayati prāgamutaḥ samāveśo bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti sūtre evakāraḥ kimarthaḥ | na ca kṛtyādayo bhāvakarmaṇoreva yathā syuḥ kartari mā bhūvannityetadarthasūcanāya sa iti vācyam | tayoriti sūtrasya "kartari kṛt' iti sāmānyaśāstrapavādatvādevoktārthasiddherityāśaṅkya, kṛtyapratyayeṣu kartrarthasyāpi samāveśo'stīti jñāpanārthamevakāraḥ | tathā ca kartrarthasyāpi samāveśe prāpte tannivṛttyarthamevakāra iti sbāṃśe cāritārthyam | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu bhavyādiṣu śabdeṣu karturapi pratītiriti | ata eva goyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnāmiti kartari, geyāni māṇavakena sāmānīti karmaṇi ca prayoga upapadyate | tadāha--tayorevetyevakāra iti | tathā ca bhavyageyeti sūtre (sū.3-4-68) vāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu yadyevaṃ jñāpyate tadā "dāśagoghnau saṃpradāne' (sū.3-4-73) "bhīmādayo'pādāne (sū.3-4-74) ityatrāpi samāveśaḥ prāpnoti | tathā ca kartaryapi teṣāṃ prayogaḥ syādityata jñāha--ādikarmaṇītyādinā | athaṃ bhāvaḥ--ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartarītyevāstu nārthaścaśabdena | evakārajñāpitāt pūrvoktavacanādeva caśabdārthasya samāveśasya siddheḥ | kṛtastu cakāro jñāpayati ādikarmaṇi ityetasmātpareṣu sūtreṣu kartrā samāveśo na bhavatīti | tathā ca dāśagoghnādiṣu na kartrarthasamāveśa iti | iti tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ <4> atha cacurtho'dhyāyaḥ jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṭhapuṃyogāt ākhyāyām ' (sū.4-1-48) iti ṅīṣvidhānāt jñāpakāt nātaḥ (praṣṭhaśabdāt) taddhitotpattiriti | jhrvi.ṭa puṃyogādākhyāyām ' sūtrasya praṣṭhī pracarī ityūdāharaṇaṃ pradarśitaṃ bhāṣye | praṣṭhasya strī ityarthe praṣṭhaśabdāt ṅīṣ | nanu praṣṭhasya strī ityarthe "tasyedam' ityarthasadbhāvāt aṇrūpastaddhitaḥ prāpnotītyāśaṅkyāha--iti ṅīṣvidānāditi | yadi hi praṣṭhaśabdāt niyamena taddhitotpattirbhavet tarhi aṇṇantatvāt "ṭiḍhḍhaṇañ' (sū.4-1-15) iti sūtrema ṅīpaiva prāṣṭhī iti rūpasiddhau "puṃyogādāśyāyām' iti ṅīṣvidhānamanarthakamāpadyeta | na ca aṇantānṅīpi ṅīṣi vā rūpe viśeṣaḥ | nāpi svare, ṅīṣa udāttatvavat ṅīpo'pi "anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' iti sūtreṇa udāttatvāt | tataśca ṅīṣvidānaṃ vyarthaṃ sat na praṣṭhaśabdāttaddhitotpattirbhavatīti jñāpayati iti bhāvaḥ | na ca bānoriyamityarthe bhānuśabdāt "vṛddhācchaḥ' (sū.4-2-114) iti sūtrema chapratyaye ṭāpi bhānaviyā iti bhavata | tatra ṭāpaṃ bādhitvā ṅīṣvidhānārthaṃ puṃyogāditi sūtramastu| tathā ca kathaṃ tajjñāpakamiti vācyam | tarhi ākhyāgrahaṇavairyathyāt | tat vyarthaṃ sat jñāpayati taddhitotpattimantareṇaiva yaḥ puṃvācakaḥ śabdaḥ striyāṃ vartate tataḥ ṅīṣ iti | bhānavīyā ityatra yaḥ puṃvācakaḥ bhānuśabdaḥ sa na striyāṃ vartate, yaśca striyāṃ vartate chapratyayāntaḥ sa na pumākhyā iti tatra na ṅīṣ | praṣṭhaśabdastu taddhitaṃ vinaiva satrīvācakatvāt tataḥ ṅīṣ bhavati | tena praṣṭhaśabdānna taddhita iti parthavasitamiti hṛdayam | jhrjñā.pā.ṭa svāṅgāccopasarjanāt (sū.4-2-54) || "sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca' (sū.4-2-57) iti pratiṣedāt jñāpakāt ānantodāttādapi bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopadhāt' iti sūtre upasarjanāditi vyartham | "bahuvrīheścāntodāttāt' (4-1-52) iti sūtrāt bahuvrīherityanuvṛttyaiva upasarjanādityasya lābhāt | na ca saṃniyogaśiṣṭanyāyena antodāttādityasyāpyanuvṛttirbhavediti tadvāraṇārtham "upasarjanāt' ityupādīyate | upātte ca tasmiṃstadbalāt upasarjanamātrāt svāṅgadantodāttādanantodāttādapi ṅīṣ bhaviṣyatīti vācyam | jñāpakamahimnaiva antodāttādityasya "svāṅgācca' iti sūtre'nuvṛttirnāstītyavagamāt | jñāpakamāha--sahanañvidyamāneti | sahetyāditrikapūrvātsvāṅgāt ṅīṣ niṣidhyate | sakeśā akeśā vidyamānanāsikā ityudāharaṇāni | tatra sahādipūrvasya bahuvrīheḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare śeṣanighātena svāṅgasya nāstyantodāttatvamiti "svāṅgāccopasarjanāt ' ityanena ṅīṣaḥ prāptyabhāvāt prataṣiedho'narthakaḥ san antodāttādityasyānuvṛttyabhāvaṃ jñāpayati | tathā cānantodāttādapi sahādipūrvāt ṅīṣprāptau tatpratiṣedhakatayā sahanañsūtraṃ sārthakam | tathā ca bahuvrīherityetāvanmātrasyānuvṛttyaiva upasarjanādityasya lābhasaṃbhavāt upasarjanagrahaṇaṃ māstu ityāśayaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ḍhaki lopaḥ (sū.4-1-133)|| etadeva jñāpayati bhavati pitṛṣvasurḍhak iti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu pitṛṣvasṛśabdāta "ḍhaki lopaḥ' iti sūtreṇāntyasya ṛkārasya lope paitṛṣvaseya iti rūpamiṣyate | tanna sidhyati | pitṛṣvasṛśabdāt ḍhagvidhāyakānuśāsanābhāvādityata āha-- etadeveti | pitṛṣvasṛśabdāt ḍhako'bhāve ḍhaki pare tasya lopavidhānamasaṃgataṃ syāditi ḍhaki lopavidhānameva pitṛṣvasṛśambdāt ḍhak bhavatītyatra bhavatītyatra jñāpakamiti bhāvaḥ | anena jñāpakena śubhrādiṣu pitṛṣvasṛśbdapāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ | yadvā "strībhyo ḍhat' (sū.4-1-120) ityatra strībhya ityarthagrahaṇamiti jñāpanīyam | ataḥ pitṛṣvasurḍhaksiddhiriti udyotakāraḥ pratyapādayat | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa brāhmaṇamāṇava-(sū.4-2-42)|| yañi prakṛte yanvidhānaṃ jñāpayati anyebhyo'pyayamiti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "brāhmaṇamāṇavavāḍaḍḍatdh;vādyan' iti sūtreṇa vigrahe bāḍaḍḍatdh;vaharaṇamiti bhavati | deyaṃ yaḥ svīkaroti sa hārītyucyate | tathā ca bāḍaḍḍatdh;vaśabdasya hārivācitvāt tasya rdhamyavācini haraṇaśabde pare anena ādyudāttatvaṃ prāptam | tathā "ano bhāvakarmavacanaḥ' (sū.6-2-150) iti sūtreṇa uttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ ca prāptam | tatra paratvāt uttarapadāntodāttatvena hārisvarabādhāt hārisvarāpravṛtteḥ tanniṣedhakam aharaṇa ityetadhdyarthaṃ sat kṛtsvaro hārisvaraṃ na bādhate api tu hārisvara eva kṛtsvaraṃ bādhata iti jñāpayati | na ca "gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' iti paratvāt kṛtsvare prāpte haraṇottarapade'pavādatayā "ano bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prānnoti | tatprāptyanantaraṃ "saptamīhāriṇau rdhamye'haraṇe' ityucyate | evaṃ ca "aharaṇe' ityanena hārisvaraṃ "ano bhāva' iti svaro na bāghata iti jñāpanasaṃbhave'pi kṛtsvaro hārisvaraṃ na bādhata iti kathaṃ jñāpayituṃ śakyat iti vācyam | kṛtsvarabādhakasya "ano bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti svarasya "saptamīhāriṇau' iti svaro bādhaka iti jñāpite tadbādhakabādhakasya sutarāṃ tadbādhakatvasya kaimutikanyāyena siddheḥ | tataśca sāmānyataḥ kṛdviṣaye yena kenāpi pareṇa sūtrema prāptasya svarasya sarvasya pūrvavipratiṣedhena hārisvaro bādhaka iti jñāpyate | itthaṃ ca haraṇaśabde pare'pi bhavediti īyaṅiṃvadhānaṃ sārthakam | tena śaṅkha ityādau "āyaneyī' iti sūtraṃ na pravartata iti | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ikoci (sū.7-1-73)|| ajgrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati bhacavatīha kaścidanyo'pi prākāraḥ pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nometi | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaiko'ci vibhaktau' iti sūtre ajgrahaṇamuttarārthamityuktaṃ vārtikakāreṇa | tatra bhāṣyakāraḥ yadyuttarārthaṃ syāt tarhi tatraiva kuryāt iha kriyamāṣasya tasya vibhaktiparakatvābhāvādeva num na bhaviṣyatīti ajgrahaṇaṃ vyartham | na ca pratyayalakṣaṇena vibhaktiparatvamāśaṅkanīyam | "na lumatāṅgasye' ti niṣedhādityāśaṅkya evaṃ tarhi siddhe sati yadajgrahaṇaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati bhavatīha kaścidanyo'pi prakāraḥ pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāma | tathā ca pratyayalakṣaṇena vibhaktiparakatvāt trapu ityādau numi prāpte tadvāraṇāya ajgrahaṇam | evaṃ jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ vārtikam | acirasyodāharaṇam tisṛṇāṃ catasṛṇāmiti | tisṛ ām catasṛ ām ityubhayatrāpi "aci ra ṛtaḥ' (sū.7-2-100) iti rādeśe "hrasvanadyāpaḥ' (sū.7-1-54) iti nuḍaḍḍatdh;āgame ca prāpte paratvāt rephādeśe kṛte nuḍaḍḍatdh;āgamo na prāpnoti | ataḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena aci rādeśaṃ bādhitvā nuḍaḍḍatdh;āgamo bhavatīti vārtikasyāśayaḥ | tadanantaraṃ "na vā nuḍiḍḍatdh;vaṣaye rapratiṣedhāt' upasaṃkhyānamapi anāvaśyakamiti nyarūpayat| tanmanasikṛtyāha--na tisṛcatasṛ iti pratiṣedha iti | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa vibhāṣā bhāvādi (sū.7-2-17)|| yogavibhāgo jñāpakaḥ yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādheḥ pratiṣedha iti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "āditaśca' "vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ' (sū.7-2-16,17) iti sūtradvayamaṣṭādhyāyyāṃ paṭhyate | tatra prathamasūtrasya ākāreto dhātorniṣṭhāyā iṇna syādityarthaḥ | prasvinna ityudāharaṇam | dvitīyasūtrasya bhāve ādikarmaṇi ca ādito niṣṭhāyā iḍḍḍatdh;vā syādityarthaḥ | tatra sūtradvayaṃ māstu "ādito vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ' ityekameva sūtraṃ kriyatām | bhāve ādikarmaṇi ca ādito dhātorvibhāṣā iṭ iti sūtrārthaḥ | tarhi kartari iṭpratiṣedhaḥ kathaṃ labhyayate iti cet-"yasya vibhāṣā' (sū.7-2-15) iti sūtreṇa labhyate | yasya kvacit vibhāṣā iḍuḍḍatdh;ktaḥ tato niṣṭhāyā iṇna syāditi tasya sūtrasyārthaḥ | tataśca ādito bhāvādikarmaṇorvibhāṣā iṭaḥ uktatvāt kartari niṣṭhāyāḥ yasya vibhāṣeti iṇniṣedhaḥ sidhyati | tathā ca yogaṃ vibhajya prathamasūtrasya iṇniṣedhaparatayā dvitāyasya veḍiḍḍatdh;vadhāyakatayā ca varṇanaṃ kimarthamityāśaṅkya, ata evaivamekena yogena siddhe yogavibhāgakaraṇaṃ jñāpayati yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādheḥ pratiṣedha iti | yādṛśaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya vikalpaḥ vihitaḥ tādṛśaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭa eva pratiṣedho'pi bhavitumarhati | tatra ca bhāvādikarmaṇorupādhyorvikalpavidhānāt kartari niṣṭhayā yasya vibhāṣeti iṭaḥ pratiṣedho na syāt | bhāvādikarmaṇorapi vikalpapratiṣedhayorasaṃbhavāt pratiṣedho na syāt | tathā ca sūtravairyathyaṃ syāt | ataḥ kartari karmaṇi ca niṣṭhāyā iṭpratiṣedhāya, bhāve ādikarmaṇi ca vikalpena iḍiḍḍatdh;vadhānāya ca yogavibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ | yadupādheriti jñāpanasya phalaṃ tu vida jñāne iti dhātoḥ "vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām' (sū.7-2-68) iti sūtreṇa vasorvikalpena vividivān vividvān ityevamiḍiḍḍatdh;vadhānāt niṣṭhāyāṃ vidita ityatra "yasya vibhāṣā' iti iṇniṣedhaḥ praptaḥ | sa ca uktajñāpakādvāryate | "vidlṛ lābhe' ityasyaiva grahaṇamiti tasyaiva vikalpenaiṭ vihita iti tasyaiva "yasya vibhāṣā' ityanena iṭpratiṣedhaḥ na jñānārthakasyeti jñānārthakasya vidita iti rūpasya siddhiriti bhāṣyādiṣu nirṇītam | tadabhisandhāyāha--yogavibhāga iti | atra ca "yadyapi hantinā sāhacaryaṃ viderasti tathāpi ca ajāgāri, jajāgāra ityubhayatrāpi guṇāpravṛttipūrvakavṛddhisiddhiriti | tatrāpi satyapi guṇe ajāgar i, jajāgar a ityavasthāyāṃ "ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhyā iṣṭarūpasiddheḥ kiṃ tayorguṇapratiṣedhena | īdūdantatvābāvāt nadīsaṃjñāyā aprāptyāna pūrvoktadoṣa iti yū ityasya prayojanaṃ vaktavyam | tattu prayojanaṃ jñāpakena ābantasya nadīsaṃjñāyāḥ vārayituṃ śakyatvādayuktam | tathā hi--yadi ābantasyāpi tadetadāha--iti pṛthagiti | tathā ca ābantasya nadīsaṃjñāvāraṇaphalakatvaṃ thūityasya na bhavatīti mātre mātuḥ ityatra ṛkārāntasya nadītvavāraṇameva tatphalaṃ vaktavyam | tasya hi nadītve "āṇ nadyāḥ' iti tataḥ parasya ṅitaḥ āḍaḍḍatdh;āgamo bhavediti bhāṣye sthitam | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṛtaśca (sū.7-4-92)|| aṅgaviśeṣaṇametadityatra taparakaraṇaṃ jñāpakam | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ṛtaśca'(sū.7-4-92) iti sūtre ṛta ityetat kimaṅgaviśeṣaṇam āhosvidabhyāsaviśeṣaṇam | abhyāsaviśeṣaṇatvapakṣe dhātoravayavasya ṛdantasyābhyāsasya ruk rik rīk āgamāḥ yaṅluki syuriti sūtrārthaḥ | aṅgaviśeṣaṇatvapakṣe ṛkārāntasya rūpam | atastaparakaraṇaṃ kṛtam | kṛte ca tasmin kṛ kṝ ityaṅgasya hrasvaṛkārāntatvāsaṃbhavāt na tadavayavābhyāsasya rugādyāgamaprāptiriti bhāvaḥ || jhrjñā.pa.ṭa sanvallaghuni (sū.7-4-93)|| "atsamṛdṛtvara'(sū.7-4-95) iti itvabādhanārthatvavidhānaṃ jñāpayati bhavati saṃyogavyavahitānāmitvamiti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "sanvallaghuni caṅpare'naglope' iti sūtreṇa caṅpare ṇo yallaghu tasmin parato'bhyāsasya sanvatkarthaṃ bhavatītyucyate | evaṃ ca acikṣaṇat ityatra abhyāsasya itvaṃ na prāpnoti | kṣaṇadhātorṇijantāt laṅi aṭi caṅi dvitve halādiśeṣe cutve ca acakṣaṇ i at ityatra caṅpare ṇau viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī veti saṃdehe āha--nalopa ityādinā | "nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' iti sūtre'pi padasyetyadhikriyate | yadi tatsthānaṣaṣṭhī syāt tadā antagrahaṇaṃ vyartham | tathāhi sati prātipadikasyeti padasyetyasya viśeṣaṇam | prātipadikasaṃjñakasya nāntasya padasya lopa iti sūtrārthaḥ | tatra cālontyaparibhāṣyā padāntasya nakārasya lopo bhaviṣyatīti kimantagrahaṇena | kṛtaṃ ca tat padasyeti viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīti jñāpayati | tena padāvayavabhūtaṃ yatprātipadikaṃ tadavayavasya nasya lopa iti sūtrārthaḥ | tatra ca sthānaṣaṣṭhītvābhāvāt alo'ntyaparibhāṣāyāḥ anupasthitau antyasya nakārasya lopo na labhyeteti antagrahaṇaṃ antanakāralopārthaṃ kriyata iti svāṃśe cāritārthyam | viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīti jñāpanasyānyatra prayojanaṃ tu "udāttasvaritayorthaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' (sū.8-2-4) iti sūtre padasyetyadhikārāt tasya ca sthānaṣaṣṭhītve udāttasvaritayoryo yaṇ tataḥ paro yo'nudāttaḥ tadantasya padasya svaritatvamalo'ntyasya bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ syāt | tataśca kumārthau ityatraiva tatsūtraṃ pravarteta, kumārthaḥ ityatra na pravarteta| tathā hi kumārī au iti sthite udāttasya īkārasya sthāne yo yaṇ tataḥ paro'nudāttaḥ aukāraḥ tadantasya kumāryau iti padasya antyaḥ aukāraḥ tasya svaritatvaṃ yadyapi sidhyati, tathāpi kumārī jas ityatra udāttekārasthānikayaṇaḥ paraḥ yaḥ anudāttaḥ jaso'kāraḥ ilsvaraprāpteratrābhāvena vyañcanasyāvidyamānatvābhāvāditi tadantatvaṃ padasya nāsti, sakārāntatvāt iti jaso'kārasya kumāryaḥ iti svaritatvaṃ na sidhyet | padasya ityasya viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhītve tu padasyāvayavo yaḥ udāttasvaritasthānikathaṇaḥ paro'nudāttastasya svaritatvamiti vākyārthaḥ | tatra ca jasavayavākārasyānudāttasya padāvayavatvamastīti svaritatvaṃ sidhyatīti | evam "ekādeśa udāttenedāttaḥ' (sū.8-2-5) ityatrāpi prayojanaṃ bodhyam | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau (sū.8-1-18)||"na sarvamāpādādau' ityadhikārasūtram | tatrā sarvagrahaṇaṃ yadi na kriyate tadā "tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' (sū.8-1-28) iti sūtre'pyetatsūtrānuvṛtteḥ atiṅantātparasya tiṅantasyānudāttatvamucyamānam "ādeḥ parasya' iti ādereva syāt | ādibhinnasya na syāt | iṣyate tu tiṅantasya sarvo'vayavo'nudātta iti | tadarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti prayojanaṃ vaktavyam | idaṃ ca prayojanaṃ jñāpakenāpi sidhyatītyāha-- na luṭ iti | "na luṭ' iti sūtreṇa hi atiṅantātparaṃ luḍaḍḍatdh;ntaṃ na nihanyata ityucyate | luḍaḍḍatdh;ntasya nighātaprāptiśca "tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti sūtreṇeti vaktavyam | tena sūtreṇa āderevānudāttatvaṃ yadi vidhīyeta tadā luḍaḍḍatdh;ntasya nighātapratiṣedho vyarthaḥ | ādyudāttasya luḍaḍḍatdh;ntasyābhāvāt | luḍaḍḍatdh;nte tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvāttāsirudāttaḥ | tatra kartetyādau ṭilopaviṣaye udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttaḥ | kartārāvityādau madhyodāttaḥ | ādyudāttastu luḍaḍḍatdh;nto nāsti yasya prāptamanudāttatvaṃ pratiṣidhyeta | ato "na luṭ' iti pratiṣedho vyarthaḥ san jñāpayati "tiṅṅatiṅa' iti sūtre ādeḥ parasyeti nopatiṣṭhate | tathā ca padāvayavasyānāderapi anudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti | tena kartā kartārāvityādau antamadhyayorapyanudāttatve prāpte tanniṣedhakatayā "na luṭ' iti sūtrasārthakyam | ataḥ sarvasyeti māstu iti bhāvaḥ | nanvevamapyādeḥ parasyetyasyāpravṛttāvapyalontyaparibhāṣayā antyasyaiva nighātaḥ syāditi tadvāraṇārthaṃ sarvagrahaṇamastvityata āha--gatyarthaloṭeti | "gatyarthaloṭā' (sū.8-1-51) iti sūtreṇa lṛḍaḍḍatdh;ntasya nighātaḥ pratiṣidhyate | sarvaṃ ca lṛḍaḍḍatdh;ntaṃ lasārvadhātukānudāttatvena madhyodāttamiti nigātasya prāptyabhāvena pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ san alo'ntyasyeti na pravartata iti jñāpayati | tathā cārthāt sarvasyānudāttatvalābhāt sarvagrahaṇaṃ māstu iti bhāvaḥ | vastuto bhokṣye iti lṛḍaḍḍatdh;ntasyāntodāttasya sadbhāvāt tasya alontyanighāte prāpte tatpratiṣedhārthatayā gatyarthaloṭā ityasya caritārthatvāt ajñāpakatvāt sarvagrahaṇam āvaśyakamiti bhāṣye spaṣṭam || jhrjñā.pa.ṭa nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya (sū.8-2-7)|| ahangrahaṇaṃ rūparātristhantareṣūpasaṃkhyānaṃ vā jñāpakaṃ nānantyasya rurmavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhanalopaḥ prātipatikāntasye' ti sūtravihito nalopaḥ ahobhyāmityatrāpi prāpnotītyaśaṅkya nalopaḥ prāpnotīti vācyam | anava kāśasya rornalopabādhakatvāt nalopaṃ prati rutvasyāsiddhatve hi rutvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | ahanśabde rutvapravṛttikāle nalopasyāpi prāpteḥ antyasya nakārasyaiva rutvaṃ vidheyam | tasyaiva nalopaḥ pratipadikāntasyeti lopo'pi iti anavakāśena rutvena nalopasya bādhāt "aḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|no nalopapratiṣedha' iti vārtikamanāvaśyakamiti paratvaṃ nāstītyutvāpravṛtteḥ utvaphalakaṃ rutvaṃ na vidadhyāt rephādeśameva vadidhyāt | yataḥ rutvaṃ vihitavān ato jñāpayati nānantyasya rurmavatīti | tathā cāntyasya nasyaiva rutve lopo'pi tasyaiveti anavakāśena rutvena nalopabādhāt ahorūpamityādisiddhiriti svāṃśe cāritārthyam | jñāpanaprayojanaṃ tu ahobhyāmityādau nalopo na bhavatyapi tu rutvameveti | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṭhasaṃjñāyām' "āsandīvat' (sū.7-2-11), (8-2-12)|| "īvatyāḥ' (sū.6-1-221) iti jñāpayati bhavatyahīvatyādau vatvamiti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "saṃjñāyām' "āsandīvadaṣṭhīvaccakrīvatkakṣīvaddrumaṇvaccarmaṇvatī' ityanayoḥ kimekasūtratvam uta bhinnasūtratvam | yadyekasūtratvaṃ tadā atrāpaṭhitānāṃ ahīvatī kapīvatītyādīnāṃ vatvaṃ na prāpnoti, asaṃjñātvāt | bhinnasūtratve prathamasūtreṇa matormasya vatvaṃ, dvitīyasūtreṇa āsandīvadādīnāṃ nipatanaṃ ca kriyata iti vaktavyam | tathā sati ikṣumatī drumatī ityādāvapi prathamasūtreṇa vatvaṃ prāpnoti saṃjñātvāt ityāśaṅkya, yathecchasi tathāstu iti bhāṣyakāra uktavān | tatra ekasūtratvapakṣe kathaṃ ahīvatītyādau vatvaprāptiḥ ityāśaṅkyāha--īvatyāḥ ityādināḥ | "īvatyāḥ' iti sūtreṇa īvatyantasya śabdasyāntodāttasvaro vidhīyate | ahīvatī munīvatī ityudāharaṇam | yadī ahīvatītyādau vatvaṃ na bhavet "īvatī' iti śabdasvarupasyaiva durlabhatatā īvatyā ityanuvādaḥ asaṃgataḥ syāt | tathā ca īvatyā iti nirdeśo jñāpayati bhavatyevaṃjātīyakānāṃ śabdānāṃ vatvamiti | "nanu āsandīvadādyartha īvatyā iti syāditi kathaṃ jñāpa kametaditi cenna| striyāmeṣāṃ prayogābhāvādeṣāmīvatīśabdāntatvābhāvāditi" keyaṭagrantho'trānusandhātavyaḥ || jhrjñā.pa.ṭa nudavidonda (sū.8-2-56)|| ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍanīgrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati bhavatyetasmādvidhiriti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "nudavidondratrāghrāḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nībhyo'nyatarasyām' iti sūtreṇa kiṃ nudādibhyaḥ parasya niṣṭhākārasya natvaṃ vikalpena vidhīyate, uta vikalpena pratiṣidhyate | kimayaṃ yogaḥ vidhiḥ uta niṣedha iti yāvat | tatra vidhiriti pakṣe naḥ iti vaktavyam | na ca "radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ' iti sūtrāt (8-2-42) naḥ ityanuvartiṣyata iti vācyam | "śuṣaḥ kaḥ' "paco vaḥ' (sū.8-2-51,52) ityādibhiḥ nakārasya vyavacchinnatvāt | prātiṣedhapakṣe tu nudādibhyo niṣṭhātasya yat prāpnoti tanna bhavatītyantareṇāpi nakāragrahaṇaṃ nakārasya pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati | paraṃtvatra pakṣe ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ bhavati ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīdhātoḥ parasya niṣṭhātasya natvaprāptyabhāvāt | nudādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ "radābhyāṃ' ityanena trā ghnā ityanayoḥ "saṃyogāderāto dhāroryaṇvataḥ' (sū.8-2-43) ityanena prāptesteṣāṃ niṣedho yuktaḥ na tu ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīdhātoḥ, ataḥ kataraḥ pakṣaḥ āśrayaṇīya ityāśaṅkya, vidhipakṣaṃ sarmathya pratiṣedhapakṣo'pi "athavā punarastu pratiṣedhaḥ' ityādinā bhāṣye samāśritaḥ | tatra pakṣe ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīgrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārtham "ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīdhātoḥ parasya niṣṭhātasyāpi natvaṃ bhavatīti' | na hyaprasaktasya pratiṣedhaḥ saṃbhavati ityāśayavānāha--ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīgrahaṇamiti ||jhrjñā.pa.ṭa nityaṃ samāse (sū.8-3-45)|| anuttarapadasthasyeti pratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ bhavati vākye vibhāṣeti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya' iti sūtre anuttarapadasthasyetyetat paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityādau visargasya ṣatvavāraṇārthamupādīyate | tatrānena ṣatvābhāve'pi "isusoḥ sārmathye' (sū.8-3-44) iti sūtreṇa ṣatvāpattiḥ | na ca tatra sūtre sārmathyapadena vyapekṣālakṣaṇaṃ sārmathyamevāśrīyate, paramasarpiḥ- kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityādeḥ samāsatvena ekārthībhāvalakṣaṇasārmathyasattve'pi vyapekṣālakṣaṇasārmathyābhāvāt na pūrvasūtraṃ pravartate iti vācyam | sārmathye iti sāmānyataḥ śravaṇena dvividhasyāpi sārmathyasya pūrvasūtre grahītuṃ śakyatvāt | na ca tathāpi kṛtpratyayayo isūsorgrahaṇāt pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣyā sarpis ityasya isantatve'pi paramasarpis ityasya isantatvābhāvena paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityatra pūrvasūtreṇa ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti vācyam | evaṃ sati "paramasarpiṣkaroti ' iti vākye'pi pūrvasūtreṇa ṣatvavikalpānupapatteḥ ityāśaṅkāṃ manasi nidhāyāha--anuttarapadasthasyeti pratiṣedha iti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--"nityaṃ samāsa' iti sūtre isusorityanuvartate | tatra yadi isusorviṣaye pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣopatiṣṭheta tadā paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityatra paramasarpiḥ śabdasya isantatvābhāvenaiva ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti vimanuttarapadasthasyetyanena | kṛtaṃ ca tat isusorviṣaye pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā na pravartata iti jñāpayati | tena "isūsoḥ sārmathye' iti pūrvasūtre'pi tasyāḥ apravṛttyā paramasarpiṣkaroti iti vākyo'pi ṣatvaṃ vikalpena sidhyatīti | bhavati vākye vibhāṣā ityasya pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣāyāḥ apravṛttidvārā ityādiḥ | evaṃ ca paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityādau ṣatvavāraṇāya pūrvasūtre vyapekṣālakṣaṇameva sārmathyamāśrayaṇīyamiti tattvām iti | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ādeśapratyayayoḥ (sū.8-3-59)|| "sātpadādyoḥ' (sū.7-3-111) iti sātpratiṣedho jñāpayati bhavati pratyayāvayavasyāpi ṣatvamiti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaādeśapratyayoḥ' iti sūtre ādeśaḥ pratyayaśca yaḥ sakāra iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayapakṣe kariṣyati hariṣyatītyādau ṣatvaṃ na prāpnoti, sakārasya "sya' iti pratyayāvayavatve'pi pratyayatvābhāvādityāśaṅkya, bhāṣye jñāpakena pratyayāvayavasya sasya ṣatvaṃ sādhitam| tadāha--sātpadādyoriti | "sātpadādyoḥ' iti sūtreṇa sādavayavasya padādeśca sakārasya ṣatvaṃ pratiṣidhyate | tatra sādavayavasya sakārasāya pratyayatvābhāvena "ādeśapratyayayayoḥ' iti ṣatvāprāptyā tanniṣedho vyarthaḥ san pratyayāvayavasyāpi "ādeśapratyayoḥ' ityanena ṣatvaṃ bhavatīta jñāpayati | tatasca sāditi pratyayāvayavasya sasyāpi ṣatvaprāptau tanniṣedhaphalakaṃ sādgrahaṇaṃ sārthakam | itthaṃ ca kariṣyatītyādāvapi ṣatvaṃ setsyatīti bhāvaḥ | tatraiva ādeśaḥ pratyayasya ca yaḥ sakāraḥ tasya ṣatvamiti vyākhyānāntaraṃ pradarśitam | tatra pakṣe prathamāntādeśaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhyantapratyayaśabdasya ca samāso nopapadyata ityāśaṅkya jñāpanāt samarthanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhāṣye | tadāha-- jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṭhaśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' (sū.8-3-60) iti ghasigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ nānāvibhaktyoreṣa samāsa iti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaśāsivasidhasīnāṃ ca' iti sūtreṇa ghaseḥ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate | jakṣaturityudāharaṇam | yadi ādeśaḥ pratyayasya ca yaḥ sakāra iti na syāt tadā ādeśasya yaḥ saḥ tasya ṣatvamityarthaḥ syāt | tadā ghaseḥ adadhātvādeśatvena tadavayavasya sasya ādeśapratyayayorityanenaiva ṣatvasiddheḥ ghasigrahaṇamanarthakam | kṛtaṃ ca tat ādeśaḥ pratyayāvayavaśca yaḥ sakārastasya ṣatvamiti sūtrārthaṃ jñāpayat nānāvibhattayoḥ ādeśapratyayayoḥ samāsaḥ na tu samānavibhaktikayoriti jñāpayati | tathā ca ghaseḥ sakārasya ādeśatvābhāvāt ṣatvāprāptai tatprāpti tatprāptiphalakaṃ śāsivasīti sūtre ghasigrahaṇaṃ sārthakamiti bhāvaḥ | atra pratyayāvayavaparapratyayaśabdena ādeśaśabdasya dvandvaḥ | tathā ca samānavibhaktikayoreva samāsaḥ | tathāpi ṣaṣṭhyantapratyayaśabdārthalākṣaṇikatvātpratyayaśabdasya vyadhikaraṇavibhaktikatvoktirityavadheyam | na ca ghasigrahaṇaṃ ādeśaśabdo nādeśāvayavapara ityatraiva jñāpakamastu noktavacane, athavā yathāśrutādeśaśabdapratyayabdayoḥ samānavibhaktikayoreva samāsa ityatraiva jñāpakamastu iti vācyam | samānavibhaktikayoḥ samāsasya jñāpakasādhyatvā bhāvāt | asati bādhake samānavibhaktikayoḥ samāsaḥ | prakṛte ca kariṣyatītyādau ṣatvānupapatteḥṣaṣṭhyantapratyayapadena samāsa iti niścite ādeśaśabdasyāpi tatsamānavibhaktikasyaiva samāso'stu iti śaṅkāyāmuktajñāpakena ādeśaśabdasya prathamāntatvamiti niścite nānāvibhaktyoreṣa samāsa ityarthataḥ parthavasānāditi | jhrjñā.paṭa na raparasṛpi (sū.8-3-110)|| savanādiṣu aśvasanipāṭho jñāpayati aniṇantādapi ṣatvaṃ bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "na raparasṛpisṛjispṛśispṛhisavanādīnām' iti ṣatvaniṣedhasūtre savanādigaṇe aśvasaniśabdapāṭho vyarthaḥ | na ca tatpāṭhābhāve tadavayavasakārasya ṣatvāpattiriti vācyam | (sū.8-3-103) iti sūtreṇa hi ṣatvaprāptirvaktavyā | tatra iṇa ityasyānuvṛtteḥ iṇantapūrvapadātparasyaiva sasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate | aśvasaniśabde ca sakārasya iṇantapūrvapadātparatvābhāvena ṣatvāprāpterityāśaṅkaya jñāpakatayā tatpāṭhasārthakyāmāha--savanādiṣviti | tathā ca kvacidaniṇantātparasyāpi ṣatvaṃ bhavatīti jñāpyate | tenāśvasaniśabde'pi ṣatvaprāptau tatpratiṣedārthaṃ savanādiṣu tasya pāṭhaḥ kriyate | jñāpanaprayojanaṃ tu jalāṣāhaṃ māṣa ityādau ṣatvasiddhiriti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ (sū.8-4-41)|| "toḥ ṣi' (sū.8-4-43) iti pratiṣedho jñāpayati neha saṃkhyātānudeśo bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' iti sūtre "yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānām' iti sūtreṇa yathāsaṃkhyāmanvayena sakārasya ṣakārasya ṣakāreṇa yoge ṣakāraḥ, tavargasya ṭavargeṇa yoge ṭavargaḥ ādeśa iti sūtrārthaḥ syāt | tatasca rāmaṣṭīkate peṣṭā ityādau ṣṭutvaṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha--toḥ ṣi iti pratiṣedha iti | "toḥ ṣi' iti sūtreṇa tavargasya ṣakāre pare ṣṭutvaṃ niṣidhyate | san ṣaṣṭha ityudāharaṇam | yadi ca "ṣṭunā ṣṭu' riti sūtre yathāsaṃkhyamanvayo bhavet tadā tavargasya ṭavargeṇa yoga eva tat sūtraṃ pravarteta na ṣakāreṇeti san ṣaṣṭha ityādau ṭavargāpravṛtteḥ "toḥ ṣi' iti sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ bhavet | kṛtaṃ tat sūtraṃ "ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' ityatra yathāsaṃkhyānvayo neti jñāpayati | ato rāmaṣṭīkata ityādisiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || iti prathamaṃ jñāpakasaṃgrahapariśiṣṭam
